name: page-flow
description: 多风格页面转场效果预览器
interaction: Users select from a gallery of transition styles (fade, slide, morph, glitch, etc.) and click to trigger live page-to-page animations rendered in real-time. Each transition is previewed on a split-screen canvas where the outgoing and incoming pages visually dissolve into one another, with adjustable speed and easing controls for fine-tuning.
